shortDescription: TORONTO, Nov. 13, 2026 /CNW/ -- Sabio Holdings Inc. (TSXV:SBIO) (OTCQB: SABOF) (the "Company" or "Sabio"), a Los Angeles-based ad-tech company helping global brands reach, engage and validate (R.E.V.) streaming TV audiences, announces that Carl Farrell has resigned as a director of the Company, eff…

children: "), a Los Angeles-based ad-tech company helping global brands reach, engage and validate (R.E.V.) streaming TV audiences, announces that Carl Farrell has resigned as a director of the Company, effective November 13, 2026.

"On behalf of the Board and the entire Sabio team, I want to thank Carl for his contributions to the Company during his time as a director," said Aziz Rahimtoola, Chief Executive Officer of Sabio. "The Board will continue to assess its composition and governance requirements following Carl's departure. We appreciate Carl's guidance and commitment, and we wish him continued success.

In line with our focus on building a leaner organization, we have implemented several cost reduction initiatives, including restructuring our cloud infrastructure, which are expected to result in annualized cost reductions of over US$5 million in 2027."

, OTCQB: SABOF) is a technology and services leader in the fast-growing ad-supported streaming space. Its cloud-based, end-to-end technology stack works with top blue-chip, global brands and the agencies that represent them to reach, engage, and validate (R.E.V.) streaming audiences.

Sabio consists of a proprietary ad-serving technology platform that partners with the top ad-supported streaming platforms and apps in the world, App Science®, a non-cookie-based software as a service (SAAS) analytics and insights platform with AI natural language capabilities, and Creator Television® (Creator TV), the first creator-led streaming network and content studio dedicated to bringing the authenticity and energy of social media storytelling to TV. For more information, visit: sabioctv.com
